description: North American F-86F Sabre, Iranian Air Force serial 3-121, displayed in the grounds of the Sa'dabad palace complex.
Republic F-84G Thunderjet, Iranian Air Force serial 2-148.
DHC-2 Beaver, c/n 558, recorded under the US Army designation L-20B with Iranian Air Force serial 6-9704.

Captured Iraqi Air Force Mi-25 attack helicopter, serial 3128, c/n 09545. The Mi-25 was the export version of the Mi-24D and was used extensively by Iraq against Iranian forces; this is one of the most significant war trophies in the country.
